description: This file defines abstract base classes and interfaces for handling file transformations and file endpoint operations related to language models, particularly in the context of OpenAI and similar providers. It includes abstract methods for creating, retrieving, listing, deleting, and fetching content of files, along with configuration classes that require subclasses to implement provider-specific logic.

classes.name: BaseFilesConfig
classes.description: Abstract configuration class for file operations, requiring provider-specific implementations.

classes.name: BaseFileEndpoints
